name: Retired Sportsperson Pension Scheme
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** A Pension of ₹3,000/- per month.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should be a sportsperson. - The applicant should be aged above 50 years at the time of application. - The applicant should have won medals in national-level sports competitions representing the state.
